name: French B2/C1 - France currently
description: In this module, knowledge of French as a foreign language will be further developed, enabling students to communicate with a native speaker actively and with a certain degree of fluency on topics of general interest or in familiar specialist areas and to argue a point understandably. In order to consolidate speaking and writing skills, certain French grammatical structures will be reviewed and extended. This module offers a cross-section of contemporary French culture, in which social tendencies, as reflected in newspaper articles, and radio and television programs, will be discussed. Topics suggested by students for examination are welcome. Students must independently prepare and deliver a short presentation on a cultural, social or scientific topic connected with France and then answer questions afterward.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of Level B.1; placement test result B.2.
